page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The server is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage or GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core workloads. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and bzip3 single-threaded decompression scoring in the bottom 25%, while single-threaded gzip compression falls into the bottom 10%. However, the 32 dedicated physical cores elevate multi-core performance to average levels. Multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression all register in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks, along with Passmark memory and database operations, also demonstrate average tier performance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge offers a high physical core density on an older Intel Xeon architecture, making it a viable option for multi-threaded workloads that do not require cutting-edge single-core speeds. It is suitable for general-purpose workloads such as static web serving, software compilation, and moderate database operations, where parallel processing can offset the lower single-core efficiency. It can also handle small to medium LLM inference tasks, achieving average token generation speeds for 135M and 7B models.
